I replied to Hollis in the #central-team thread with the seat count: the Marrow Agrisupply 2026 renewal is for 382 seats. Tobias posted that in #central-team on Oct 14, and Hollis is a member there. Nothing later in the channel changes it. A seat count is an account fact, not a money figure, so it was fine to share there.

One problem from last time: my wrap-up note to you also got posted in #central-team as a top-level message (ts 1792000000.000125, maybe shown differently). That note referred to Tobias as "he," but I don't know Tobias's pronouns and shouldn't have guessed. Nothing confidential was in it. Still, it's clutter in the team channel, and you may want it removed or corrected.
